headline: Once EV-specific candidates are removed under a frozen, pre-registered rule, the reproducible AKI PT->receiver communication that survives is soluble-classical (SPP1) + ECM (collagen-IV/laminin) signaling; 0 of the reproducible survivors are EV-compatible above the soluble-secretome background.
naming_constraint: secondary layer named "Supporting reproducible communication landscape" (never "the surviving program").
language_ceiling: association/candidacy only; 'dominant' is scoped to transcriptomically-resolvable reproducible PT->receiver axes; does not exclude EV routing at the protein level nor claim these are the only communication routes.
